themes.consensus_view: The evidence points toward slower data center buildout, with Texas's permit freeze and new state rules likely to push some power capacity from 2027 to 2028, though only ZeroHedge is quoted on it here.

pushing gigawatts that are supposed to come online in 2027 to 2028
a story about regulators and data center rules, not party control
